No DSA sparse-MLA attention backend in vLLM accepts CC 8.x, so DSA models (GLM-5.3 and GLM-5.3-Flash) fail at attention-backend selection on Ampere and Ada. Pipeline parallelism does not work (wrong output, counted as not starting): On CUDA the registry entry resolves to DeepseekV32ForCausalLM (a DeepseekV2ForCausalLM subclass with SupportsPP), so pp>1 starts, but the PP handoff carries only hidden_states and residual while GLM-5.3 layers reuse the previous layer's indexer top-k (index_topk_freq 4); a stage that starts on a reusing layer (the default pp=2 boundary is layer 39) reads a stale top-k. Open PR #59961 measured GSM8K 0.879 vs 0.908 for pp2 tp2 and showed VLLM_PP_LAYER_PARTITION=38,40 (boundary on a fresh-top-k layer) restores accuracy. Workaround: VLLM_PP_LAYER_PARTITION=38,40 puts the stage boundary on a layer that computes a fresh top-k (open PR #59961 measured it restoring accuracy at pp=2). GLM-5.3 (GlmMoeDsaForCausalLM) always uses DSA sparse MLA, and every sparse-MLA backend in vLLM requires CC 9.x, 10.x or 12.x (FLASH_ATTN_MLA_SPARSE and FLASHINFER_MLA_SPARSE_SM90 need major==9, FLASHMLA_SPARSE needs major 9 or 10). On Ampere/Ada the selector raises 'No valid attention backend found' while loading the model, and the DeepGEMM lightning indexer has no pre-Hopper kernel either.
